tools.name: check_domains
tools.description: Check whether domain names are actually available to register, using live registry (RDAP) data. Use this when suggesting domain names (verify availability before presenting them, never assume a name is unregistered) or when the user asks whether specific domains are available. Accepts up to 50 fully

tools.name: get_tld_prices
tools.description: Get registrar retail first-year price estimates in USD for top-level domains (.com, .io, .app, .dev, .ai, …). Use this when the user is comparing TLD options, e.g. 'should I get the .com or the .io?'. For the exact purchase price of a specific domain, use check_domains instead.
